title: Classical motor imagery dataset with left hand, right hand, and rest
description: This dataset contains 19-channel EEG recordings from 7 healthy participants performing classical motor imagery of the left hand, right hand, and passive rest. Participants responded to visual arrow cues in offline sessions, without feedback. The recordings were made with a Nihon Kohden EEG-1200 system at 200 Hz. The data support brain-computer interface research and motor imagery classification benchmarking.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 19 scalp channels (10-20 system) with a Nihon Kohden EEG-1200 at 200 Hz, with earlobe grounds (A1, A2) and a 50 Hz line frequency. Trials used a 1 s visual arrow cue followed by a 1.5-2.5 s inter-trial interval. Participants imagined left-hand or right-hand movement, or stayed passive, with no feedback.
